title: Settlement Decision Workbench - Scenario Parameters, Labels & Policy Clause Map

reimbursement_documents: Proof of payment to the workshop

labels.rate_variance: Quoted rate above benchmark rate card
labels.idv_basis: Settled on IDV (agreed value) basis instead of the requested value
labels.salvage_retained: Salvage value retained by the owner
labels.pro_rata: Pro-rata reduction for underinsurance (IDV / market value)
labels.floor_cap: Floor at zero / IDV cap adjustment
labels.basis_garage_quote_plus_supplementary: Garage quote plus supplementary estimate as submitted
labels.basis_market_value: Market value of the vehicle at date of loss, as expected by the customer
labels.outcome_cashless: Repaired vehicle returned by the network garage; insurer pays the garage directly
labels.outcome_reimbursement: Cash reimbursement after GST invoice, proof of payment and repair completion
labels.outcome_repair: Repaired (not replaced) panels; insurer pays the garage directly
labels.outcome_partial: Approved lines repaired now; withheld line payable once evidence is supplied
labels.outcome_supplementary: Revised settlement covering the original repair plus hidden damage
labels.outcome_total_loss: Total loss payout against surrender of the vehicle and its documents
labels.outcome_ctl_retention: Constructive total loss payout; owner keeps the wreck and its assessed salvage value is deducted
labels.outcome_ctl_not_triggered: Repair threshold not reached; repair settlement stands
labels.outcome_addon: Repair settlement with the add-on applied
labels.outcome_deductible: Repair settlement at the selected excess levels
labels.outcome_pro_rata: Repair settlement reduced pro-rata for underinsurance (what-if)
labels.role_settlement_agent: Settlement recommendation agent (recommendation only, always routed to a human)
labels.skip_amount_exceeds_limit: amount exceeds the role's settlement limit
labels.skip_claim_type_not_allowed: claim type is not in the role's allowed list
labels.skip_condition_blocked: an active condition requires a higher tier
labels.maker_checker_note: Maker and checker must be different users (IN-DOA-MATRIX-2026); bulk approval is forbidden.
labels.approval_demo_note: Illustrative authority resolution for a synthetic claim - no real approval has been recorded.
labels.assessor_decision_holdback: Claims handler withheld the line and opened an evidence follow-up instead of rejecting the claim
labels.assessor_decision_none: No lines withheld; all assessed lines approved
labels.assessor_decision_reinspection: Surveyor re-inspection required because the supplementary uplift crossed the variance threshold
labels.assessor_decision_no_reinspection: Supplementary uplift is within the re-inspection variance threshold
labels.option_repair: Repair and refinish bumper and fender

scenarios.label: Cashless garage repair
scenarios.summary: The insurer settles the approved amount directly with a network garage; the customer pays only the excess and any non-admissible amount.
assumptions: Network garage is bound to the benchmark rate card, so duplicate and above-benchmark quote lines are removed before billing.
Customer pays the difference between the assessed repair invoice and the insurer's payment at the garage.

clauses.applied_for: Accidental external means is an insured peril
Standard parts depreciation schedule applied line by line
Part and paint depreciation waived
Consumables covered instead of fully deducted
Excess deducted once from the amount payable
Cashless settlement directly with the network garage

scenarios.label: Reimbursement claim
scenarios.summary: The customer repairs at any workshop, pays the invoice and is reimbursed the admissible amount against documents.
assumptions: Non-network invoice is assumed equal to the quoted amount, so the customer first funds the whole invoice.
The insurer's admissible amount is identical to cashless; the difference is who funds the repair and how much stays with the customer.

clauses.applied_for: Accidental external means is an insured peril
Standard parts depreciation schedule applied line by line
Part and paint depreciation waived
Consumables covered instead of fully deducted
Excess deducted once from the amount payable
Reimbursement against GST invoice, payment proof and completion confirmation

scenarios.label: Repair vs replacement
scenarios.summary: Compares replacing the bumper and fender with repairing and refinishing them; labour carries no depreciation and paint only 25%.
assumptions: Surveyor and damage assessment confirm both panels are technically repairable; safety-critical parts are always replaced.
Repair lines use the garage's alternative repair quote for the same panels.

clauses.applied_for: Insurer may repair instead of replace where feasible and safe
Paint material depreciated at 25%; labour at 0%
Paint depreciation waived
Consumables covered instead of fully deducted
Excess deducted once from the amount payable

scenarios.label: Partial approval
scenarios.summary: One line is withheld because evidence is missing; the rest is approved now and the withheld line can be released later.
assumptions: The withheld line is held, not rejected, so the customer can still supply evidence (IRDAI fair-documentation principle).
While the line is withheld the customer funds it at the garage.

clauses.applied_for: Only damage proven to arise from the insured accident is payable
Unproven or pre-existing damage is outside cover
Missing evidence triggers structured follow-up, not rejection
Standard parts depreciation schedule on approved lines
Part and paint depreciation waived
Excess deducted once from the amount payable

scenarios.label: Supplementary estimate
scenarios.summary: Hidden damage is found on dismantling; the settlement is recomputed on the cumulative estimate and only the increment is newly payable.
assumptions: Supplementary lines are notified before repair and assessed at the quoted amount.
The excess is applied once on the cumulative claim, never again on the supplementary.

clauses.applied_for: Supplementary estimate, re-inspection threshold and cumulative authority check
Standard parts depreciation schedule on supplementary parts
Part depreciation waived on supplementary parts
Consumables covered instead of fully deducted
Excess applied once across original and supplementary

scenarios.label: Total loss
scenarios.summary: Irreparable damage, fire or theft: the insurer pays IDV less excess against surrender of the vehicle and takes the salvage.
assumptions: Surrender basis: the insurer takes ownership of the wreck, so no salvage value is deducted from the payout.
The customer expected the market value of the vehicle, but an agreed-value policy settles at IDV.

clauses.applied_for: IDV is the agreed value and the maximum payable on a total loss
IDV less excess paid against surrender of the vehicle
Excess deducted once from the amount payable

scenarios.label: Constructive total loss
scenarios.summary: A severe structural estimate is tested against 75% of IDV; if the net repair cost crosses it the claim converts to a total loss with the owner retaining the wreck.
assumptions: Stress estimate is a single aggregate structural repair line set as a fixed share of IDV (rule parameter).
Retention basis: the owner keeps the wreck, so its assessed salvage value is deducted from the payout.

clauses.applied_for: Net repair cost tested against 75% of IDV
IDV is the agreed value and the maximum payable
Salvage retained by the owner is deducted
Excess deducted once from the amount payable

scenarios.label: Salvage recovery
scenarios.summary: After a surrender-basis total loss the insurer sells the wreck; compare its net claim cost with letting the owner retain the salvage.
assumptions: Salvage auction proceeds equal the assessed salvage value; disposal cost is a fixed share of proceeds (rule parameter).
The customer receives the same payout as the total-loss scenario; only the insurer's net cost changes.

clauses.applied_for: Insurer is entitled to the salvage on surrender; retention deducts its value
IDV is the agreed value and the maximum payable
Excess deducted once from the amount payable

scenarios.label: Zero-depreciation add-on
scenarios.summary: Shows exactly what the Zero Depreciation endorsement is worth on this claim by recomputing with and without it.
assumptions: All other inputs, including the consumables add-on, are held at their current values.
Claim-count limits in the policy schedule are not modelled.

clauses.applied_for: Depreciation on replaced parts and paint waived
Standard depreciation that applies without the endorsement
Excess deducted once from the amount payable

scenarios.label: Consumables add-on
scenarios.summary: Shows what the Consumables endorsement is worth by recomputing with and without it; without it consumables are fully deducted.
assumptions: All other inputs, including the zero-depreciation add-on, are held at their current values.

clauses.applied_for: Consumables covered instead of fully deducted
Consumables are otherwise excluded as wear and tear items
Excess deducted once from the amount payable

scenarios.label: Different deductibles
scenarios.summary: A grid of compulsory excess by vehicle class against voluntary deductible slabs, showing the net payable for each pairing.
assumptions: Premium discount earned for a higher voluntary deductible is not modelled.
The headline figure uses the compulsory and voluntary excess currently entered.

clauses.applied_for: Compulsory excess by vehicle class plus any voluntary deductible
Standard parts depreciation schedule applied line by line
Part and paint depreciation waived
Consumables covered instead of fully deducted

scenarios.label: Underinsurance and IDV implications
scenarios.summary: Compares IDV with market value: the IDV cap, the shortfall on a total loss, and what a pro-rata average would do to a partial loss if the policy carried one.
assumptions: The synthetic wording applies no pro-rata average to partial loss by default; the reduction shown is a what-if for policies or segments whose wording provides for it.
Pro-rata is applied to the loss after depreciation and before the excess.

clauses.applied_for: IDV cap, agreed-value basis and any pro-rata condition in the schedule
Total loss is paid at IDV, not market value
Excess deducted once from the amount payable
